title: kernel & Kernel: priority uid filter: Fix UAF bugs and worker not able to run
message:
kernel & Kernel: priority uid filter: Fix UAF bugs and worker not able to run

- Two synchronize_rcu(); are missing in susfs_set_priority_uid_filter() and susfs_priority_app_strings_worker() that could lead to UAF.

- For "susfs_priority_app_strings_worker()" kworker, it should be run after "track_throne();", See comments above the "ksu_defer_track_throne()".
